name: bkesari-mobile
description: Android and iOS apps for bkesari.com: the bkesari app (one bkesari ID with Google sign-in, D-039) and the earlier per-project shells for LadWani, Education and TaskList. See README.md.

scripts.sync:bkesari: node scripts/vendor.mjs && cd bkesari && npx cap sync
scripts.add:android: for a in ladwani education tasklist; do (cd apps/$a && npx cap add android); done
scripts.add:ios: for a in ladwani education tasklist; do (cd apps/$a && npx cap add ios); done
scripts.sync: for a in ladwani education tasklist; do (cd apps/$a && npx cap sync); done
